label: late copy-phase steps whose input is h/e/0/z (and other favored tokens)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never during the original tokens or on <DEL>. Firing rate rises steeply with position: about 0 at recall_idx 0-1, 1.5% at 2, 6% at 3, 15% at 4, and 25-38% at recall_idx 5-8, so most mass comes from long sequences (L 7-9) near the end of the copy (to_go 0-2). Within those late copy steps it is strongly gated by the identity of the fed-back input token: h (27% rate, 28% of mass), e and 0 (about 22% each), then z, with weaker firing on y, k, t, 1, g and little on most other tokens. The strongest activations are on h/e/0/z at the last copy steps of length-8/9 sequences. Position alone (recall_idx >= 4) gets 92% of mass but only 23% precision; adding the token set gives F1 about 0.63 on dev with 80% mass recall. The token preference is graded rather than a clean set, so precision and recall both stay incomplete.
